title: Dual Wield
body:
Syntax: dual wield <carried weapon>  |  remove offhand

Description: Equip a second weapon in your off hand. Mastery can grant one extra off-hand attack each combat round for 5 Stamina. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 70. Costs 0 Chakra and 5 Stamina; 0 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
